title: Frozen BTC/ETH Deribit dealer-GEX versus next-15-minute realized-volatility screen

mechanism.type: prospective public-data same-day diagnostic with a 12-transition event stop and 90-minute hard cap; no trading rule
mechanism.registered_rule: Aggregate dealer-mirror taker-flow GEX by underlying and UTC 15-minute signal block using Black-Scholes gamma from each trade's IV, index price, and captured metadata. Compare each nonzero signal block with complete realized volatility in the immediately following 15-minute index block.
mechanism.registry_lineage: accelerated-intraday-contract.json; frozen before outcomes; same-day falsification/prioritization only

authoritative_definition_of_trades.taker_direction: trade.direction buy=+1 / sell=-1 recorded verbatim; tick_direction (0..3) is last-price tick direction, NOT taker side, and is stored but not used for GEX
authoritative_definition_of_trades.amount_units: coin (BTC/ETH) per official docs for options; contracts field equals amount when present; contract_size fetched from instrument metadata (=1.0 verified)
authoritative_definition_of_trades.premium_units: option 'price' is in coin (inverse); premium_usd = price x index_price (index_price USD is embedded per trade)
authoritative_definition_of_trades.gamma_units: ticker greeks.gamma = dDelta/dS per 1 USD underlying move (standard Black-Scholes per official docs); gamma==0.0 for deep-OTM quantized rows is valid data, not missing
authoritative_definition_of_trades.index_price: USD; trade-embedded index_price preferred; ticker.index_price and deribit_price_index pushes recorded as fallbacks

sources_verified_official.fields: trade_id, trade_seq, direction(taker), tick_direction, index_price, price(coin), amount(coin), contracts, iv, liquidation, block_trade_id, combo ids
greeks{delta,gamma,theta,vega,rho} options-only, standard Black-Scholes without adjustments; theta=min(1d,lifetime) nonstandard; index_price, underlying_price, mark_iv, open_interest(coin)
instrument seeding via public/get_instruments (REST); amount units for options = underlying coin; raw interval authorized-only; per-currency trade channel recommended; markprice.options has NO greeks
get_instruments low-rate-limit warning; used with daily seed + channel-tracked lifecycle instead of polling
strike, option_type, expiration_timestamp, contract_size=1.0, lot_size, tick_size, settlement_currency, price_index, is_active

20 real trades pulled as replay fixture; direction taker semantics consistent with docs; trade_id unique per currency; trade_seq per instrument

data_used.terms: Public unauthenticated market data only; no credentials, orders, or private endpoints; official docs prescribe polling limits; collector rate usage minimal (1 seed/currency/reconnect + 3 WS channels kinds).

parameters.greeks_channel: ticker.{instrument}.agg2 channels exist but are NOT used by the default configuration; --capture-tickers opts into them for the open option chain (no default ticker-chain readiness)
parameters.instrument_lifecycle: startup + reconnect + daily 00:00 UTC reseed via public/get_instruments (REST); NO instrument.creation / instrument.state subscription is claimed in the default configuration (channels exist on the platform but are not subscribed here)
parameters.ready_banner: DERIBIT_CAPTURE_READY printed+flushed only after the 4-channel default (2 option-trade + 2 index) subscribe acks return the exact requested set AND the set_heartbeat ack returns ok; ticker channels are opt-in via --capture-tickers and are EXCLUDED from default readiness
parameters.shutdown_banner: DERIBIT_CAPTURE_STOPPED on clean SIGTERM/SIGINT or cap fail-closed
parameters.rotation: sink rotates BEFORE every write whenever the capture UTC day changes; the day_rotation_open record is itself checked against both caps.
parameters.ticker_capture: opt-in only via --capture-tickers; NOT default (bandwidth safety)
parameters.greeks_policy: The accelerated screen uses only standard Black-Scholes gamma from each trade's iv(%), index_price, and captured strike/expiry/contract_size metadata. Missing or invalid inputs fail closed; ticker gamma is never used by fast_intraday.py.
parameters.legacy_replay_greeks_policy: The older run.py replay may prefer captured ticker gamma when optional superseded ticker data exists; that policy is retained only as legacy replay provenance and is not authoritative for the accelerated screen.
parameters.subscribe_ack: readiness requires ack result to contain every requested channel (set equality); verified by stub tests + live smoke
parameters.byte_accounting: exact encoded bytes; startup reconciliation counts every day dir (today's dir loaded at first rotate); rotation-open event itself respects both caps; fsync per write
parameters.heartbeat: public/set_heartbeat requires params {interval:10} (verified); client replies public/test
parameters.restart_state: rehydrate_state() seeds persisted instrument ids + bounded recent trade dedup ids from the active-day files before the first REST seed
parameters.readiness_gate: DERIBIT_CAPTURE_READY prints only after every subscribe batch ack returns returned == requested (exact set equality) AND public/set_heartbeat {interval:10} acks result=ok. Any empty/partial/superset/errored ack forces a reconnect instead.
parameters.day_scoped_metadata: on day rollover, _persisted_instruments resets so the new day's instruments.jsonl carries strike/expiry/contract_size for BS reconstruction; same-day reconnects write nothing via rehydrated persisted ids.
parameters.backoff: resets only after a stable ready session; escalating 1s..60s otherwise; stop-aware sleeps (~0.1s wake)
parameters.raw_once_semantics: raw JSONL is at-least-once across restarts; run.py dedup-by-deterministic-id is the authoritative exactly-once view.
parameters.stop_grace: <180 s stop grace recommended because synchronous urlopen waits may spend up to 20 s per attempt (and thus up to ~40+ s across the 2-currency REST seed); SIGTERM latency observed 0.01 s when stop fires between network operations
parameters.rehydrate: run() wraps startup (rehydrate_state + seed) in the SAME stop/finally lifecycle as the session loop; SIGTERM during rehydrate or in-flight REST seed closes the sink once and prints DERIBIT_CAPTURE_STOPPED with no traceback

signal_timing: Deribit trade.timestamp assigns GEX signal blocks and data.timestamp assigns immediately following realized-volatility blocks. Receipt time is provenance only. The frozen screen used non-overlapping UTC 15-minute transitions through the 2026-08-30T18:31:13Z hard deadline.

cost_model.note: No trading, returns, or costs. Realized volatility is a public-index risk descriptive; no execution or deployment claim.

benchmark: Registered dependence gates: pooled and per-asset Spearman, negative/positive dealer-GEX next-RV ratio, and transition-level leave-one-out stability.

first_falsification_gate: Frozen accelerated screen: at least 1,000 GEX-computable trades, 12 complete asset-block transitions, four per asset, and three blocks per GEX sign; then require pooled Spearman <= -0.25, negative/positive next-RV ratio >= 1.1, negative BTC and ETH correlations, and at least 70% nonpositive leave-one-out correlations.

risks: Public 100ms trade aggregation cannot reveal sub-100ms taker interleaving.
Venue retention limits for public trade history are undocumented; this screen uses prospective capture only.
Black-Scholes gamma depends on reported trade IV and captured instrument metadata; invalid inputs fail closed.
Single-venue dependence means a Deribit outage or API change halts capture.
Public index cadence does not make every 15-minute outcome block complete under the frozen >=720-observation and <=5-second-gap rules; incomplete blocks fail closed.
Ten transitions are below the registered twelve-transition minimum, so descriptive false gates do not change the inconclusive truth.
Independent review cleared the final same-day result; active persistent capture is operational evidence only and does not extend the screen.
next_experiment: Closed FROZEN-NEGATIVE. Do not pool, extend, tune, or re-window the parent, superseded, corrected, or event-stop windows.

The 2026-09-02 owner authorization for a same-mechanism retest is spent. Any further Deribit options work requires a genuinely different mechanism with its own preregistration, stopping rule, multiplicity boundary, and claim boundary.
